BiblicalUsage: Dan-Jaan is named once, as a place on the border of David's census, between Gilead and the land of the Hittites. It is a boundary marker in a counting that would bring a plague.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a boundary town has its place in the story, marking how far the king's pride reached.
